faq.q: How much does Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes two offices, in Mesa and Peoria. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers?
faq.a: Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Genesis Personal Injury & Accident Lawyers publishes six case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
